current_status_source_of_truth: this result supersedes the parent manifest execution status; the parent remains immutable because its hash is part of every corrected checkpoint contract

not_supported: This does not show that PQN, LEO, Dual LEO(PQN), or discrete SAC cannot exploit either defect; the fixed/mutant main comparison never opened.
Sparse rewarded transitions do not establish stable learning of delivery or any auxiliary goal.
The two candidate settings and two development seeds do not establish a general failure of value-based or entropy-based reinforcement learning.
The finite final-checkpoint evaluation does not exclude success on untested states or a transient policy at an earlier checkpoint.
interpretation.operational_decision: Keep the 72-job main matrix closed. Do not automatically extend replay, budget, candidates, or architectures. If continuing this branch, preregister the already-proposed one-method, one-environment PQN comparison between a delivery-near reset and the original natural reset to distinguish local value learning from long-horizon action linking.
interpretation.supported: Under the corrected preregistered two-candidate, two-seed fixed-normal settings, all four online methods encountered commanded delivery transitions and most jobs encountered at least one delivery-ge-3 success in persisted rollout snapshots. No final checkpoint succeeded in any of the recorded deterministic evaluations: 1,024 natural-start episodes and 1,024 common-setup episodes.

normal_capability_gate.per_job_result: all 32 jobs scored 0/32 in both deterministic greedy evaluation families
normal_capability_gate.selection_note: all candidate scores tied at zero; registry-order selections are operational tie-breaks, not evidence of superiority

operations.guard_note: one transient unmarked GPU PID caused a fail-closed stop; no signal was sent to it. After it disappeared and a marker-bearing keepalive appeared, that keepalive was identity-checked, terminated, and the guard resumed without interrupting training.
